# History, comments and live updates

The changes of each record, comments on it, and pages that refresh as records change.

- [Record history](../reference/history.md#on-the-record-page): Every change to a record is kept with who made it and when, including changes made outside the API.
- [Activity](../reference/history.md#activity): Admins see all changes across resources in one list.
- [History retention](../reference/history.md#keeping-it): Changes older than a set number of days are removed by a daily job.
- [Comments](../reference/comments.md#on-the-record-page): Anyone who can read a record can read and add comments on it.
- [Mentions](../reference/comments.md#mentions): Mentioning a colleague in a comment sends them an email with a link to the record.
- [Comment moderation](../reference/comments.md#moderation): Admins find and delete comments across the app.
- [Live updates](../reference/live.md#what-a-page-hears): Open lists and record pages refresh within seconds when a record changes, including changes made outside the API.
- [Change stream](../reference/live.md#the-stream): Apps follow record changes over a stream that catches up after a reconnect.
